A multiplier feature automatically comes with your ticket to multiply any nonjackpot prize won by up to 10 times! A unique multiplier (2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X) will print on each board of your ticket. Any nonjackpot base prize won on that board will be multiplied by that number! The multiplier assigned to the play is randomly assigned at the time of purchase.

qualifications: Note: Straight/Box can only be played for $1 or $5. Combo tickets cost 3 to 6 times the single play amount, depending upon the numbers selected. If you do not choose a play type or wager amount, Pick 3 tickets default to a 50-cent Straight wager on a paper playslip and a $1 Straight wager on a digital playslip.

On occasion, certain popular Pick 3 numbers may "sell out" and cannot be purchased. Unlike jackpot games, daily games pay out an established prize regardless of how many tickets are winners. In order to adequately fund these fixed prizes, the Lottery establishes a prize liability limit on these games and restricts sales of tickets for such drawings if the liability limit would be exceeded by the drawing of any particular numbers.
